title: Webhook Integration Testing Plan — Runnable Companion
title_es: Plan de Testing de Integración Webhook — Companion Ejecutable
description: Runnable companion for the webhook testing plan template: a Stripe-style HMAC signature verifier with node:test cases (valid, tampered, expired, wrong secret) and a retry/DLQ simulator showing the backoff schedule and dead letter transition.
description_es: Companion ejecutable de la plantilla de plan de webhooks: un verificador de firma HMAC estilo Stripe con casos node:test (válida, alterada, expirada, secret incorrecto) y un simulador de retry/DLQ que muestra el backoff y la transición a dead letter.
